description: Create a Prized sandbox: an isolated Linux microVM (Ubuntu 24.04) to run code in, away from this machine. Returns once it is running, usually within seconds, with the id the other tools take. Templates: prized-base-v1 (default; Python 3, Node.js 22, git, build tools) or prized-agent-v1 (adds Claude Code and Codex). Commands run as the user prized in /home/prized/work, with outbound internet; no sudo or apt, and Python packages go in a venv (python3 -m venv ~/.venv). It bills per second while running. By default it pauses after 15 idle minutes (memory and processes kept; the next call resumes it) and is deleted 7 days after it pauses or when its run time ends; delete it with delete_sandbox when done.

auto_delete_minutes.description: Delete it this many minutes after it pauses, up to 40,320 (28 days). Default 10,080 (7 days); 0 keeps a paused sandbox until you delete it.

auto_pause_minutes.description: Pause after this many minutes without a command or file call. Default 15; 0 never. A background job pauses with it, so use 0 for one that must run unattended.

env_vars.description: Environment variables for every command in the sandbox, such as a key the code inside needs. Prized stores them encrypted and its API never returns them; anything running in the sandbox can read them.

labels.description: Your own key/value tags, for list_sandboxes and the dashboard, at most 30. created-by=prized-sandbox-mcp and this install's prized-mcp-scope are always added; prized-mcp-scope cannot be passed.

max_runtime_minutes.description: Minutes of running before it is deleted; each resume starts them again (on the free tier the time left carries on). Default 1,440 (60 on the free tier), at most 10,080.

memory_gb.description: Memory in GB, 1 to 128. Default 8 (4 on the free tier).

template.description: prized-base-v1 (default) or prized-agent-v1 (adds Claude Code and Codex).

vcpu.description: vCPUs, 1 to 32. Default 4 (2 on the free tier).

name: create_sandbox

autoDeleteMinutes.description: Minutes after it pauses before it is deleted; 0 or null: kept until deleted.

autoPauseMinutes.description: Idle minutes before it pauses itself; 0 or null: never.

errorReason.description: Why it is in the error state, when it is.

expiresAt.description: When it is deleted (ISO 8601), or null.

maxRuntimeMinutes.description: Minutes of running before it is deleted.

state.description: starting, running, pausing, paused, resizing, deleting or error.

template.description: The template it was made from, such as prized-base-v1.

title: Create a sandbox
